neutral_note: No Finsonly liveries exist for this airframe, so nothing is known about its stock cockpit / gear pixels: non-paint regions get flat neutral colours (nothing from GeoFS is committed).
source: GeoFS Paraglider (id 50) models/aircraft/paraglider/canopy.glb (glTF 1 binary), material ID5 (texture.jpg). The pilot is a separate model and isn't painted.
method: Every textured triangle of the model rasterized into UV space and labelled from its part name, 3D position and facing (tools/uv_regions.py). UV v runs down the image (row = v * height), verified against the helmet/pilot island. Labels come from the rule table in uv_regions.py (first match wins); faces the 26-direction visibility pass never sees are 'interior'.

geom_axes.G: height: 0 = lowest point .. 255 = top of the fin

in_sim: UNVERIFIED IN-SIM: derived from the model files, not yet checked with the region-ID sheet in GeoFS.

cross_check.stock_note: % of texels where the stock texture isn't its background colour

regions.name: canopy_centre

regions.notes: The texture is a planar front-view picture of half the canopy, mirrored: left and right halves AND the top and bottom skins all land on the same texels. Everything painted here is symmetric by construction; text reads backwards on one side.

regions.where: the rest of the span out to the tips (both halves share)
